note: Every entry is a proposal; no test exists yet unless existing_coverage names one. Issue ids resolve in aquamacs-issues.json.

regression_tests.title: Open/New document with no visible frame
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: File opened from Finder/`open -a` or File > New while every window is closed or minimized loads a buffer but shows nothing; the user sees no document.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: GLASSMACS-DOC-001, APP lifecycle: the process outlives its last frame and any document request produces a visible window showing that document.
regression_tests.expected_result: After zero visible frames, a simulated open event and `glassmacs-new-document` each yield exactly one visible frame whose selected window displays the requested buffer; no blank extra frame.
regression_tests.environment: ERT with stubbed frame primitives (all platforms) for logic; macOS GUI session for Finder/`open -a`/Dock.
regression_tests.existing_coverage: glassmacs-macos-focus-restores-final-hidden-frame; glassmacs-macos-focus-does-not-restore-unrelated-invisible-frames; glassmacs-macos-new-window-creates-a-frame; glassmacs-cocoa-file-open-event-uses-document-policy (none assert the opened buffer is displayed when no frame is visible)
regression_tests.test_plan: Extend existing lifecycle tests; manual `open -a` step in the macOS checklist
regression_tests.evidence_note: Aquamacs #270 is open (2026-10-15) against 4.0 alpha 2 and is the same failure class as Glassmacs's final-window lifecycle work; #219 and #22 are the older reports.

regression_tests.title: save-some-buffers accepts `!` (save all)
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Answering `!` to C-x s does nothing or errors, leaving many modified buffers unsaved.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Ordinary Emacs save semantics are preserved on top of Glassmacs key/menu layers.
regression_tests.expected_result: With three modified file buffers, feeding `!` to `save-some-buffers` saves all three; `y`/`n`/`q` also behave per Emacs; no Glassmacs advice intercepts the prompt.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #16 closed with fix commits 3ebeb5b and 9d409ac recorded by the maintainer.

regression_tests.title: Unsaved new-document buffers are never silently discarded
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Untitled/new documents or scratch-like buffers are killed or the app is quit without a save prompt (or prompts when it should not).
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: DOC-009: explicit recovery/discard policy for untitled work; Cmd-W/Cmd-Q prompt for unsaved changes.
regression_tests.expected_result: A modified buffer created by `glassmacs-new-document` triggers the kill-buffer and `save-buffers-kill-emacs` save query; an unmodified one does not; `*scratch*` obeys documented Glassmacs policy.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #158 records the cause as buffer-offer-save being forced on in *scratch* (maintainer comment). #17 is a crash report with no recorded root cause; only the save-prompt side is testable.

regression_tests.title: Startup with unwritable or missing home/config directory
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Startup fails or loops when the preferences/home directory is not writable.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Isolated GLASSMACS_HOME; startup never writes outside it and degrades with a message instead of failing.
regression_tests.expected_result: With GLASSMACS_HOME read-only or absent, Emacs starts, a diagnostic is reported, and no file is written under the real home.
regression_tests.environment: ERT subprocess (`emacs -Q --batch`), POSIX permissions; skipped as root.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #52 maintainer view: Aquamacs should not write to ~/ on Mac; #99 closed as addressed in 3.1a (unverified).

regression_tests.title: Customize changes persist to the isolated custom file
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Saved customizations (faces, safe directory-local variables, toolbar) are lost or written to the wrong place.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: OPT-003: scoped preferences persisted in $GLASSMACS_HOME/custom.el and reloaded at startup.
regression_tests.expected_result: `customize-save-variable` and a saved `default` face write only to `custom-file` under GLASSMACS_HOME and are restored by a fresh startup; no error on save.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #246: alpha 1 used wrong configuration pathnames (maintainer comment). #6: saving default-face customization produced a write error (title/excerpt; cause not recorded).

regression_tests.title: Initial frame is visible when startup needs user interaction
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Emacs 'hangs' with no window because a prompt (unsafe local variables) is waiting behind an invisible frame.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: A frame never stays hidden while a prompt blocks startup.
regression_tests.expected_result: No Glassmacs startup path hides the initial frame; a startup file triggering an unsafe local-variable query produces a visible frame (GUI) or a non-blocking decision.
regression_tests.environment: ERT for frame-parameter assertions; macOS GUI for the real prompt.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Maintainer comments on #147 attribute the hang to Aquamacs-specific startup.el hiding the initial frame. Whether Glassmacs is exposed is an open hypothesis.

regression_tests.title: Auto-revert never clobbers modified buffers
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: External file changes are not picked up, or unsaved edits are overwritten.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Data safety: unsaved edits are never overwritten silently; clean buffers track disk when auto-revert is on.
regression_tests.expected_result: With `global-auto-revert-mode`, a clean buffer updates after an external write and a modified buffer is left untouched, for both values of `auto-revert-use-notify`.
regression_tests.environment: ERT, batch; file notification available (kqueue on macOS CI).
regression_tests.evidence_note: #245: auto-revert-use-notify default changed during the Emacs merge (reporter/maintainer). Glassmacs does not configure auto-revert, so this is a verification of upstream behavior.

regression_tests.title: Keyboard and key-binding invariants
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Super bindings vanish after C-h b; Shift-Tab becomes C-y; `single-key-description` differs from GNU Emacs; menus advertise wrong keys.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: KEY-001/KEY-003: hybrid bindings coexist with Emacs; effective keymap drives labels.
regression_tests.expected_result: After `describe-bindings` Super bindings remain; `<backtab>` is not translated; `(single-key-description ?s)` is "s"; menu key labels equal `where-is-internal` results.
regression_tests.evidence_note: All five are closed with documented fixes in Aquamacs-specific osx-key-mode code (e.g. #28 commit d40dc75); Glassmacs does not use that code, so these test its own bindings.

regression_tests.title: Unicode round trip through an R/ESS console
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Non-ASCII text sent to or printed by R is garbled (comint/process coding).
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: LANG-002/RESEARCH-001: UTF-8 text survives send, queue and output filtering.
regression_tests.expected_result: A region containing multi-byte characters is sent through the Glassmacs queue and echoed by R verbatim; output budget/filter does not split characters.
regression_tests.environment: ERT with real R and ESS (the CI integration job); skipped otherwise.
regression_tests.existing_coverage: glassmacs-sessions-integration-real-ess and the real-ESS output tests (ASCII only; no Unicode case)
regression_tests.evidence_note: #53 closed Unreproducible (maintainer could not reproduce); #132 reports ipython colors/encoding with no resolution. Treat as hypothesis-driven coverage, not a confirmed defect.

regression_tests.title: System clipboard round trip with external applications
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Cmd-V pastes stale text after a rectangle operation until Cmd-C is pressed inside Emacs.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: EDIT-001: kill ring and macOS pasteboard stay consistent.
regression_tests.expected_result: After `pbcopy`, Emacs yank inserts the pasteboard text, including after `cua-rectangle` use; Cmd-C text is readable by `pbpaste`.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #47 is still open; the maintainer could not reproduce it (comment). Keep as acceptance check rather than assumed defect.

regression_tests.title: Open-file and drag-and-drop honour the document policy
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: `open -a` opens a new frame despite policy; dropped files open in the wrong frame.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: DOC-001/FILE-003: `new-frame`, `new-tab` and `reuse-current` apply to Finder opens, drops and menus.
regression_tests.expected_result: For each policy a simulated `ns-find-file` and `ns-drag-n-drop` event opens the file with the expected frame count; reopening a visible file focuses it.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #39 closed 'fixed in master'; #84 closed unresolved pending retest (maintainer comment).

regression_tests.title: Native crash and dialog acceptance checklist
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Closing a full-screen window, or arrow keys / OK in Open and Save panels, crashes or hangs the app.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Application lifecycle and file dialogs never crash or hang.
regression_tests.expected_result: Checklist passes on supported macOS versions: close single full-screen frame; Open/Save As with arrow keys; Open dialog from Recent Files; read-file-name for an existing file uses the open panel.
regression_tests.environment: Physical macOS, Apple Silicon and Intel, current and previous macOS.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Aquamacs fixes are patches to its own Cocoa code (changelog L36, L83) and GNU Emacs bug#26323 (#160). Whether Glassmacs's bundled Emacs is affected is a hypothesis.

regression_tests.title: Menu-bar update with R and TRAMP buffers
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Menu bar activation crashes with poly-R or Dired-over-TRAMP buffers.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Menus never trigger R queries or remote I/O and never crash.
regression_tests.expected_result: Opening menus with an ESS console, a poly-R buffer and a TRAMP Dired buffer causes no crash and no connection attempt.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #180 maintainer links GNU Emacs bugs 34762 and 26982; #196 closed without recorded cause.

regression_tests.title: TRAMP file as the first document
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Opening a remote file with no local file open blocks the UI.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Remote opens never freeze the first window.
regression_tests.expected_result: With a fake remote file-name handler, the first document opened under each policy returns control and creates the expected frame.
regression_tests.environment: ERT, batch with fake TRAMP handler.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #103 reported a scp: hang that resolved itself after about a minute and later could not be reproduced (comments).

regression_tests.title: emacsclient / server file opening
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: emacsclient opens an unwanted frame or fails with `windowp` error against the bundled Emacs.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Command-line open (`glassmacs`, bundled emacsclient) honours the document policy.
regression_tests.expected_result: Bundled emacsclient connects and opens a file with one document frame under `new-frame` and none extra under `reuse-current`.
regression_tests.environment: macOS CI job with the built app (bundle); daemon-free server.
regression_tests.existing_coverage: none (Glassmacs does not configure the server)
regression_tests.evidence_note: #247/#249 are 4.0 alpha reports with an unknown cause (maintainer: 'still rather mysterious').

regression_tests.title: Frame cycling and window deletion
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: `other-frame` flip-flops between two frames; delete-other-windows closes frames; ordering lost after full screen.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: DOC-006: standard Emacs frame/window commands behave normally under one-document-per-frame.
regression_tests.expected_result: With three frames `other-frame` visits all; `delete-other-windows` never deletes a frame.
regression_tests.environment: ERT with stubbed frames; macOS GUI for full-screen ordering.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Aquamacs fixes were in Aquamacs frame code (e.g. #46 commit 0918781); Glassmacs uses stock commands so this is characterization.

regression_tests.title: File locks and removable volumes
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Killed buffers keep a lock or handle so external drives cannot be ejected.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Closing a document releases its lock/file handle.
regression_tests.expected_result: After saving and killing a buffer, no `.#file` lock remains and the file can be removed.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #96 could not be reproduced in 3.5 (maintainer). Low evidence; test is cheap.

regression_tests.title: Option-as-Meta versus composed characters
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Option+key shows `undefined` instead of inserting accented/national characters; left/right Option cannot differ.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: KEY-002: text input preserved by default; independent left/right modifiers configurable.
regression_tests.expected_result: Documented defaults for `ns-alternate-modifier` and `ns-right-alternate-modifier` match the keybindings doc; composed characters are not bound as Meta commands.
regression_tests.environment: ERT for variables; macOS keyboard for composed input.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #58 closed fixed per reporter; #233 solved by `(setq ns-alternate-modifier 'meta)` with `ns-right-alternate-modifier` `none` (comments). Stock GNU Emacs defaults Option to Meta, so KEY-002 may be an unmet promise: confirm before writing the test.

regression_tests.title: TLS trust and package signature setup in the bundle
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: HTTPS package archives fail (TLS errors, signature failures).
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Packaged app can verify TLS and ELPA signatures.
regression_tests.expected_result: Bundled Emacs has gnutls, a readable trust file, and `package-check-signature` keyring present.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Fixes recorded: #205 commit 29cda06, #166 commit 49134e4 (Aquamacs 3.x). Network is not required.

regression_tests.title: Session restore does not duplicate frames
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Reviving a saved desktop opens duplicate frames or breaks the menu.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: DOC-008: restore recreates saved documents once.
regression_tests.expected_result: `desktop-read` with the document policy yields one frame per saved document and does not duplicate.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #81 open; depends on Aquamacs `revive`, which Glassmacs does not use. #13 closed as no longer reproducible.

regression_tests.title: Full-screen behavior
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Black window, scrollbar flashes, or wrong geometry after full-screen toggles.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Native full-screen preserves window state.
regression_tests.expected_result: Enter/exit full screen repeatedly: content visible, scrollbar/toolbar settings unchanged, splits resize correctly.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Mostly fixed in Aquamacs-specific full-screen code; native Emacs full screen differs.

regression_tests.title: Spell-check integration fails clearly
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Spell-check menu hangs, errors or shows nothing.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: EDIT-004: missing spell tools are reported without hanging.
regression_tests.expected_result: `ispell` and Spelling menu items with no dictionary/program report a clear error promptly.
regression_tests.environment: ERT for missing-program path; macOS GUI for menu.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Aquamacs used NSSpellChecker; Glassmacs promises only maintained Emacs commands.

regression_tests.title: XML comment edit hang (bundled Emacs version guard)
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Editing XML comments hangs the editor.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Bundled Emacs includes upstream fix.
regression_tests.expected_result: Uncommenting in `xml-mode` completes within a timeout.
regression_tests.test_plan: Single guarded smoke test, not an upstream duplicate
regression_tests.evidence_note: #231 is labelled 'Fixed in Emacs 27' (maintainer).

regression_tests.title: Info manuals and Lisp source navigation in the bundle
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Info directory mangled; find-function cannot find sources; undefined-function errors in shipped Lisp.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: HELP-001: manuals and Glassmacs sources are reachable in the bundle; no void-function errors.
regression_tests.expected_result: `find-library` resolves Glassmacs libraries; `Info-directory-list` has the Emacs manual; byte-compile reports no undefined functions.
regression_tests.environment: Bundle CI job; byte-compile step already exists.
regression_tests.evidence_note: #123/#124 were void functions in Aquamacs Lisp; the Glassmacs analog is the byte-compile gate.

regression_tests.title: Display smoke checklist
regression_tests.user_visible_failure: Cursor misplaced with line-spacing, large minibuffer font glitches, line-number margin too small, anti-aliasing and click precision.
regression_tests.glassmacs_promise: Rendering uses stock Cocoa display.
regression_tests.expected_result: Visual checks on Retina and non-Retina displays pass.
regression_tests.evidence_note: Mostly historical cosmetic bugs; low confidence of recurrence.
